## Summary

What problem does this change solve? Link related issues if applicable.

## Validation

List checks run and their results. For UI changes, include the OS, desktop and
shell/TUI tested, plus a screenshot using sample data where useful.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Targets `develop` (maintainer release-promotion PRs target `main`).
- [ ] Relevant docs and regression coverage are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, personal recordings or generated build output are included.
